articleTitle: Application and Improvement of Agile Development in Intelligent Health Hut Software Project
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: As a new software system, the Intelligent Health Hut software project is characterized by exploration, creativity, and uncertainty. This makes the traditional waterfall development model unapplicable, thus allowing the agile development idea that is lighter, more flexible, and more adaptable to dynamic changes to become the preferred management mode of the project. This paper introduces the application and improvement of the Scrum method based on the agile development idea in software project management from the aspects of team building, requirements management, change management, and iterative process management, along with the characteristics of the Intelligent Health Hut software project. So as to improve the project management efficiency and project quality of Intelligent Health Hut.

articleTitle: Cloud-Client Integrated Designed Financial Robot Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Financial robot is an important means to realize the automation of financial process. Considering that there is still room for expansion in the current research on financial robots, this paper proposes a financial robot based on cloud integrated design and big data analysis, and designs the financial robot on the end side, including a financial document identification module based on deep neural network, a dialogue assistance module based on natural language processing, and an error correction check module based on cloud data; Build the financial sharing cloud on the cloud side, including the financial processing system based on database and the financial big data intelligent analysis module based on data mining. Based on the cloud integrated financial robot architecture, an intelligent reimbursement process is proposed to provide simplified services for the enterprise's accounting processing process and provide reference analysis of the financial situation for the enterprise's decision-makers.

articleTitle: Forecasting of Long-Term Natural Gas Consumption Using Linear Regression Method: A Study on Natural Gas Sector in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Forecasting of natural gas consumption for a country is essential for its logistics and future work flow. Long-term oriented natural gas consumption is also important for efficient logistics management in the power and energy sector. It is an advanced process for a country or a city to know the future demand of gas that can improve the transportation system, especially when the gas is transported through the pipelines. In this paper, linear regression method is proposed to forecast long-term natural gas consumption in Bangladesh. This method is very useful in time series data and forecasting on long term basis. The trend line of the regression can forecast the long-term based demand of the natural gas in the country. The results of this study indicate that natural gas consumption in the country is increasing over time. Gas consumption has increased rapidly in the last 5-10 years and it is forecasted that the consumption will be increased drastically for the next few years. Some statistical parameters such as MAE, MAPE, and RMSE are performed to evaluate the forecasting accuracy. It is also seen that the regression method provides good results in both cases annual and sector wise analysis. The results of this paper show that the linear regression model is capable of forecasting long-term natural gas consumption in Bangladesh.

articleTitle: A Cache-assisted Computing Offloading Strategy Based on Deep Q Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Mobile edge computing (MEC) provides users with abundant wireless resources and cloud computing capabilities to meet their computing demand. Existing works tend to consider caching and computing offloading separately, so it is difficult to achieve overall optimization of system performance. To further improve system performance in smart home scenario, a novel collaborative caching and computing offloading scheme (CCCO) was proposed in this paper. First, a new collaborative caching strategy is designed in this paper to improve the cache hit rate, i.e., smart devices cache the task's computation results and edge servers collaboratively cache the related data of the sub-tasks after task division, Then, sub-tasks are collaboratively offloaded to servers for processing. Finally, Deep Q Network algorithm is used to obtain the optimal offloading and caching decisions for minimizing system latency. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm significantly outperforms the traditional computing offloading scheme in terms of latency.

articleTitle: Research on Bidding Agency Service Evaluation for University Instruments and Equipment Procurement
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The existing bidding agency service evaluation methods could not reflect the characteristics of university instrument and equipment procurement. So, the service evaluation index system of university instrument and equipment procurement bidding agency was constructed based on SERVQUAL evaluation criteria, which included 6 first-level indexes and 28 second-level indexes. Meanwhile, there are the uncertain and definite relations of randomness and fuzziness in the index system. And the set pair analysis method is used to construct the 5-element relation number and its weighted form of the service evaluation of the university instrument and equipment bidding agency. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the method are analyzed through a case.

articleTitle: Credit Loan Default Prediction Based On Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: With the continuous development of economy and the improvement of people's level, personal credit loan develops rapidly. Because the problem of credit loan default is becoming more and more serious, the development of credit loan business needs an accurate prediction system. Banks have a lot of historical data, using data mining technology, from the basic information, social relations, consumption behavior, such as address information as much as possible in the massive amounts of customer data mining on the information of the borrowers, summed up the main factors influencing the personal credit risk prediction, and based on this model can effectively predict the personal credit risk related. The results show that the prediction accuracy of XGBoost model is higher than that of Logistic Regression model and Random Forest model.

articleTitle: Research on the Synergistic Development of Agricultural Products E-Commerce and Cold Chain Logistics
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The rapid development of China's agricultural products e-commerce has led to an increasing demand for cold chain logistics as its offline activities. However, the development of cold chain logistics has not kept pace with the development of agricultural products e-commerce in recent years. This paper aims to study the linkage development of agricultural products e-commerce and cold chain logistics. Firstly, the current development status and future development trend indicators of agricultural products e-commerce and cold chain logistics distribution are selected. Agricultural products e-commerce includes 2 primary indicators: infrastructure and level of technological development, and market development potential, and cold chain logistics includes 3 primary indicators: quality of development, infrastructure and market development potential. Each primary indicators include 10 secondary indicators. Secondly, grey relational analysis (GRA) is used to study the development of agricultural products e-commerce and cold chain logistics distribution. The results found that from 2014 to 2018, the two subsystems showed a basic uncoordinated state; from 2019 to 2021, the two subsystems were in a basic coordinated state, but there was still a certain gap from coordination. Finally, the coupling mechanism between agricultural products e-commerce and cold chain logistics is constructed. The research in this paper gives certain suggestions for the development planning of cold chain logistics for agricultural products e-commerce. It improves the business efficiency and business value of cold chain logistics enterprises and enhances the consumption experience degree of agricultural products e-commerce customers.

articleTitle: Research and enlightenment on the Graduation Rate of American Universities Based on Panel Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The undergraduate graduation rate has an important connotation of measuring the quality of higher education and plays an important role in the evaluation and assessment of the teaching quality of American universities. Based on the panel data, this paper establishes a linear regression model (selecting the data of universities from 51 states in the United States from 2009–2020) and analyzes the relationship between graduation rate and education investment policy, faculty level, student cost and so on. The conclusion is that the ratio of students to federal financial aid, state education funding and full-time instructional staff/student amount are negative to the graduation rate. Meanwhile, the state average tuition fee has a positive effect on student graduation rate. This paper innovatively introduces the analysis of panel data to the graduation rate study, and the quantitative study of higher education data has practical significance.

articleTitle: Innovation of the Higher Education Grassroots Statistical Reports System based on Low-Code Development
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The grassroots statistical reporting of higher education is not only a critical effort for the advancement of national education, but it also serves as a prominent foundation for colleges and universities in formulating development strategies. Due to numerous statistical objects, extensive fields, and complex contents, the problems of difficult data maintenance and low filling efficiency caused by traditional manual means are prone to occur. To address these issues, the low-code software development method is utilized to design and implement a higher education grassroots statistical reports system. Initially, the characteristics of low-code development are leveraged to achieve code reusability and simplify the development process. Moreover, the method emphasizes data verification to improve data quality. To handle reported data, an automatic filling flow is eventually constructed. The system's deployment optimizes data reporting, reduces the intensity of statistical work, strengthens data verification, enhances the quality of data reporting, and effectively supports statistical reports.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of Enterprise Information System Based on Docker and DevOps Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Under the background of large and medium-sized platform strategy, many excellent platform as a service architecture designs have emerged. The focus of the technical platform is to build the PaaS layer. The PaaS layer is designed to form a cluster environment with relatively distributed virtual machines provided by the IaaS layer, the main technologies to be used include Docker container and Kubernetes orchestration engine. In addition, software project development is a process of comprehensive practice, and it is far from enough to rely on Docker technology alone. In view of the lack of standardized project management, code management, testing and quality assurance means in software project development, the introduction of DevOps software development model and the study of enterprise information system architecture design are of great significance for guiding the design of large-scale distributed architecture.

articleTitle: Research on Budget Performance Management System of Universitie under Big Data: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The data mindset and analytical philosophy of Big Data have triggered a conceptual change in budget performance management. Under the background of the rapid development of big data and artificial intelligence technology, how to improve the budget performance management of universities needs the support of both systems and technology. Taking a comprehensive university in the Sichuan Province of China as a specific research case, this study explores the construction of a university budget performance management system and realizes the innovation of a university budget performance management model by using big data technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Servitization Transformation Mechanism Based on Lotka-Volterra Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Servitization of manufacturing is one of the important ways of industrial transformation and upgrading. A symbiotic evolution model of traditional manufacturing and service-oriented manufacturing was established based on the Lotka-Voterra model, and the evolution trend of these two types of manufacturing was analyzed in depth by collecting data of Guangdong Province. The results show that: (1) the Lotka-Volterra model has good adaptability to the evolution of manufacturing servitization, and the fitted data are closer to the actual value; (2) according to the model prediction results, the manufacturing industry is obviously weak in growth rate due to internal and external factors, and will grow slowly in the future and reach the limit of output level in ten years; (3) service-oriented manufacturing is parasitic on traditional manufacturing, and the development of service-oriented manufacturing will inhibit the development of traditional manufacturing.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Influence of Insurance Innovation to Corporate Violations Based on the Crawler Program by Python
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Using the web crawler technology by Python and Stata's correlation, regression, and propensity score matching analysis methods, this paper employs a large sample of A-share listed companies from 2016 to 2020 in China. It explores the impact of directors' and officers' liability insurance on firms' violating behaviors. The empirical results show that as a vital insurance innovation in the Chinese capital market, this insurance can effectively inhibit enterprises' tendency to violate regulations and prevent violations from happening. This article contributes to the literature by enriching the research methods of applying advanced computer technology to the management engineering field, providing new avenues for corporate financial innovation and risk management, and expanding the application of data mining in the field of decision making and process optimization.

articleTitle: Optimizing Supply Chain Performance of SMEs through Big Data Analytic and IT-enabled Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Nowadays, several researchers are endeavoring to uncover the influence of innumerable evolving and innovative capabilities to comprehend the impact on distinct performances of enterprises across the world. Likewise, the research on big data and information technology is acquiring an intense concentration of scholars. This study investigates the relationships among big data analytics (BDA) and IT-enabled capabilities (ITE) on enterprises' supply chain performance (ESCP) within the realm of SMEs of developing nations like Pakistan based on RBV theory and practice. Using a survey method, this study probed the nexus based on 348 responses (n=438) obtained from mainstream cities of Pakistan, including the capital city between April 2022 to June 2022. SEM model along with supporting methods, i.e., discriminate and convergent validation was carried out using SPSS and SmartPLS tools. It is found, BDA has a positive connection with ESCP. Second, the study revealed a positive nexus between ITE and ESCP, respectively. This research endows with insights for supply chain management of SMEs on how the incorporation of appearing capabilities such as BDA and ITE could optimize business performance such as supply chain performance. Furthermore, this study equips several interesting implications along with additional work potentials for the researchers to assume in the future not only within Pakistan but across the world to validate the notion of BDA and ITE in different themes.

articleTitle: A Java EE Data Persistence Layer Model Based on Design Pattern and DbUtils
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of low development efficiency and high code redundancy of traditional JDBC and improved JDBC in the development of data persistence layer, a new Java EE data persistence layer development model is proposed. The model uses factory design pattern to separate the creation and use of DAO, uses single instance pattern to encapsulate the database connection pool, uses dynamic proxy and reflection to create the implementation class object of DAO interface, uses annotation to mark the mapping relationship between entity class and data table, and uses DbUtils tool class to complete the interaction with database. The design idea and components of the model are described in detail. Taking the data persistence layer of the target assessment system as an application case, the implementation process of the model is described in detail. The test results show that this model can improve the development efficiency and reduce the redundancy of code, and its performance is almost the same as that of traditional JDBC.

articleTitle: A Synthesis of Structural Equation Model-Analytical Hierarchy Process, Nonlinear Autoregressive and Backpropagation Neural Network-Sensitivity Analysis for Construction and Demolition Waste Assessment in the Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The Philippines' Build-Build-Build initiative has led to an increasing number of infrastructures, which have a great impact on the public, natural resources, life cycle, and ecosystem. Hence, waste is inevitable during the infrastructure's construction or demolition. Thus, the factors of sustainable construction and demolition waste management (SCDWM) must be considered to evaluate. The structural equation model (SEM). nonlinear autoregressive exogeneous (NARX) neural network (NN) and backpropagation (BP) NN were conducted to predict the coefficient of determination of SCDWM's rate impact. Furthermore, the analytical hierarchy process (AHP) and sensitivity analysis (SA) were used to determine the relative importance factors of SCDWM. The assessment results of the synthesis method of SEM-AHP, BP-NN-Garson's Algorithm (GA), and NARX-SA, which are applied in the construction engineering management field provided an interesting insight into the Philippines' initiative. Utilizing SEM as causal analysis and BP-NN and NARX as machine learning would give a new recommendation for the industry 4.0 transition.

articleTitle: Research on Cold Chain Logistics Risk Control of Fresh E-commerce under New Retail
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: With the emergence of the new retail model, fresh e-commerce cold chain logistics has got a step development opportunity. How to ensure food safety from origin to table, and reduce the probability of fresh product safety accidents in the operation process of fresh e-commerce cold chain logistics is an urgent problem to be solved. This paper first determined the operation process of cold chain logistics of fresh e-commerce under the new retail, summarized the identification factors of internal and external risks of cold chain logistics, and took three main platforms of fresh e-commerce under the new retail as the research object, constructed fresh e-commerce cold chain logistics risk evaluation system including six dimensions of supply risk, circulation and processing risk, storage risk, transportation risk, distribution risk and external risk, and combined with AHP and PSO to conduct an empirical study. Finally, according to the analysis results, the corresponding conclusions and improvement suggestions are put forward, in order to reduce the decay rate of fresh agricultural products in the cold chain and improve the operation efficiency of the cold chain.

Author Keywords: Cold chain logistics risk identification and assessment

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between Innovation Culture and Innovation Ability of Internet Enterprises — Based on Signaling Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: This article used the data of the Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share Internet industry listed companies from 2015 to 2019 as a research sample to explore the relationship between corporate innovation culture and innovation ability. From the perspective of signaling theory, the influence of innovation culture on the corporate innovation ability is analyzed to help stakeholders effectively identify the innovation level of different enterprises under the condition of information asymmetry. The empirical results show that corporate innovation culture has a significant positive effect on innovation ability, and R&D investment is beneficial to strengthen the positive effect of innovation culture on innovation ability. Through the results of this paper, it is further verified that innovation culture is a signal reflecting corporate innovation and plays an important role in innovative development of enterprise. It expanded the application of signaling theory in the field of enterprise innovation and provided some practical references for the Internet enterprises.

articleTitle: A Survey of Online Buyout Price Auction Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The progress of network technology and the transformation of shopping methods provide the foundation for the design and innovation of auction mechanisms. Buyout price auction mechanisms combine the traditional posted price with the online English auction, which add new vitality to online auctions and promote the development of auction mechanism theory. First, we analyse the author cooperation and research hotspots of the literature on buyout price auctions in the core collection of Web of Science by using CiteSpace software. Then, we review the literature via a classification method and describe the evolution and research progress of online buyout price auction mechanisms. This paper divides the current literature into three aspects: the causes of buyout price, the comparison of buyout price auction mechanisms and the setting of buyout price. Finally, we discuss the issues to be studied in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of the Dual System of Agricultural Product E-commerce and Cold Chain Logistics under Low-carbon Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Focusing on the development of agricultural products e-commerce and cold chain logistics under the low-carbon economy, this paper analyzes the influencing factors of cold chain logistics and agricultural products e-commerce, uses principal component analysis method to extract the principal components of agricultural products e-commerce and cold chain logistics, and carries out correlation analysis on the dual system. It is found that the dual system has a strong correlation with the infrastructure construction and development potential, and the carbon emission has a strong correlation with the infrastructure construction of the dual system. According to the analysis results, puts forward to promote agricultural electricity under low carbon economy and the coordinated development of cold chain logistics ideas and Suggestions, to obtain rapid development of cold chain logistics and produce electricity matching degrees, to speed up the pace of reduction, decreasing the consumption and low-carbon transformation, promote agricultural electricity and cold chain logistics structure adjustment, realize the healthy and sustainable development.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis of Institutional Entrepreneurship Base on SSCI Database (1994–2021)
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Institutional entrepreneurship, as one of the forms of institutional change, opens up a new perspective for organizational theory to explain how and why institutions change. This paper makes a statistical analysis of 438 articles on institutional entrepreneurship collected by SSCI from 1994 to 2021 using bibliometric method, and summarizes the current situation, hot spots and trends of institutional entrepreneurship research.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation and Analysis of the Transformation Ability of China's Technological Achievements
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Based on the comprehensive evaluation index system for transformation ability of China's technological achievements, this paper uses AHP to calculate and determine the weight of each indicator. On this basis, by collecting and processing the relevant data, the statistical data of each indicator of the four-level indicator layer can be obtained. Finally, the weight of each indicator and its standardized data were integrated to evaluate and analyze the transformation ability of technological achievements in 29 provincial-level regions in China. It provides a scientific basis and decision-making reference promotion strategies and paths of each region for improving the transformation ability of technological achievements.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Business Environment for Districts and Counties based on Improved TOPSIS Method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Business environment is a comprehensive ecosystem of the external environment faced by enterprises when they engage in entrepreneurship, innovation, financing, investment and other activities. Under the background of the rapid development of the new generation of information technology, a good business environment can provide sufficient resource support for enterprises, improve the carrying capacity of the environment, and then promote the entrepreneurial behavior of regional enterprises. Improving the business environment is not only an inherent need for economic development, but also a practical need to improve the efficiency of digital government services, address the need to improve the business reputation of the region, and further attract investment. The optimization and improvement of business environment greatly depends on the accurate evaluation of the development level of business environment. Therefore, the effective evaluation of business environment is an important basis for the high-quality development of local economy, which is an important issue that both theoretical research and practical exploration pay attention to. In this paper, a set of multi-level business environment evaluation index system is constructed, and an evaluation model based on the improved TOPSIS method is proposed to solve the objective weighting of index system and the quantitative evaluation and ranking of evaluation objects for business environment. The empirical study using questionnaire data proves the practicability and feasibility of the proposed model, and puts forward a series of policy suggestions to promote the optimization of business environment. On the one hand, the study of this paper plays an important role in promoting the government at all levels to optimize the business environment and promote the development of local economy. On the other hand, it also plays a certain guiding role in the construction of the evaluation index system of the business environment and the quantitative comprehensive evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Digital Transformation Capability Evaluation Index System of Logistics Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data, cloud platforms and the internet of things are driving digitalization. The logistics industry is one of the earliest industries in China to apply digital technology. The application of digital technology is conducive to the integration of China's existing logistics resources. How logistics enterprises can better understand their digital transformation needs and choose the right digital transformation entry point is crucial. This paper conducts research on the evaluation of digital transformation capability of logistics enterprises, constructs the index system of digital transformation capability of logistics enterprises, determines the weight of indicators and verifies the consistency through fuzzy analytic hierarchy, aiming to provide certain reference value for logistics enterprises to improve their digital transformation capabilities.

articleTitle: Incentive Mechanism Design with Gold Standard Questions Based on Approval Voting in Crowdsourcing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Crowdsourcing has been widely used in many areas such as data tagging in machine learning these years. However, sometimes the quality of the task is not satisfied because workers lack of expertise knowledge or workers do not put all of their effort. In order to better use crowdsourcing system, it is necessary to design incentive mechanism to ensure workers try their best to propose answers in the process of completing tasks. Therefore, in this paper, we study how to design incentive mechanisms with inserting gold standard questions in the crowdsourced tasks, and applying approval voting to utilize workers' partial knowledge as much as possible. In particular, workers would pay cost for every option they selected, and get proper reward only if they select the true answer for gold standard questions. In the paper, it theoretically proves that the proposed mechanism has good properties compared with other mechanisms and meets the constraint of incentivizing workers to select all options with belief higher than the threshold and thus improves the total quality of workers' answers. Finally, experiment results show that the mechanism can improve the quality of workers' answers in completing tasks.

articleTitle: Leveraging Best Industry Practices to Developing Software for Academic Research
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Best industry practices in software development are vital to the success of a project. When these practices are not well-applied, the development process can be severely hindered, and the final product can be of poor quality as a result. Implementing techniques for managing source code: version control, issue tracking, a branching strategy, a pull request strategy, a coding standard, unit testing, CI/CD, and automated testing, are not just widely-used industry practices for no reason. Thus, we took to applying these practices to a development project for research designed to reduce user time and effort in hydrologic modeling studies, CyberWater. The software package is built on legacy software and the development team is made up of a wide variety of people from various backgrounds, not all computer science. Applying these best industry practices to their development project has made their lives easier and the final product better. We report our experience in this paper and hope it provides some useful suggestions to domain scientists in an academic setting regarding how to develop high-quality research software.

articleTitle: Seismic Damage Prediction and Classification tool: Utilizing Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) and Geographic Information System (GIS)
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Seismic damage prediction of wide range of buildings is an important prioritization and classification tool for implementation of seismic risk and vulnerability assessment. This study has developed a rapid visual screening (RVS) tool using Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) model and Geographic Information System (GIS). Hospital and public-school buildings located in districts 5 and 6 have been selected for assessment. Technical calculation basis in the development of FEMA P-154 was followed in formulating the model using the neuro-fuzzy tool package in MATLAB. Six (6) building parameters and their resulting output (final score) were inputted for training. Sub-clustering FIS model showed the lowest RMSE and R2 result out of the five (5) FIS models compared. The model showed effective performance in classifying the buildings' damage grades having 0.2908, 0.8073 and 0.948 for RMSE, and for testing and overall coefficient of determination (R2) values, respectively. Performance metrics from the developed confusion matrix showed high range of values for sensitivity, specificity, precision, and accuracy, with maximum error rate and false positive rate of 0.11 and 0.25, respectively, in classifying the buildings' damage grade. These validate the model's performance and ability in classifying the damage grade of the buildings observed. The results were used to develop a digital mapping of the damage grade distribution of the selected buildings in the area using ArcGIS.

articleTitle: Cognitive Evolution Based on Subjective Learning Promotes Cooperation in Public Goods Game
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: In order to alleviate the cognitive bias and cooperation dilemma caused by the supremacy of interests among players in the game, we take the subjective game as the research framework, propose two strategies updating models based on subjective cognition from the perspective of information fusion and emotion regulation, and study the cognitive evolution of participants in the public goods game. Through the simulation experiment on the NetLogo platform, we find that, for the decision-making process of information processing, the participants pay more attention to the long-term reputation value, which can avoid cognitive bias to some extent, and then improve the cooperation dilemma of the system through the reputation effect; For the internal emotion regulation process, individuals stick to their accumulated emotional value and improve their emotional sensitivity, which can make them have a strong resistance to the invasion of the betrayer. Our research, to a certain extent, inhibited the free riding behavior in the multi-player game situation, and maintained a high level of cooperation between groups. The strategy updating model proposed in our research provides a new way to study the cognitive evolution of players in the game process from the perspective of modeling and simulation, and has certain practical significance to help solve the problem of group cooperation dilemma.

articleTitle: A Multi-Graph Joint Learning Network with Side Information for Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The application of knowledge graph in recommendation algorithms effectively enhances the interpretability of recommendation results, but it still lacks the mining of deep semantic information. Aiming at the problem that the current knowledge graph based recommendation algorithm is difficult to fully mine the potentially related information between entities, this paper proposes a multi-graph joint knowledge graph recommendation algorithm. This model combines the ideas of metapath2vec and EGES to enhance the embedding representation of nodes by simultaneously learning the original graph composed of the node itself and the auxiliary graph consisting of their side information to improve the recommendation effect. Extensive experiments on public datasets show that, compared with other benchmark algorithms, the proposed approach has a certain improvement in accuracy and robustness, and has a better ability to deal with sparse data.
